entities.summary: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Rayagada is a diocese located in the Indian state of Orissa (Odisha). It was created, with territory taken from the Roman Catholic Diocese of Berhampur, on 11 April 2016 by Pope Francis. It is headquartered in the see city of Rayagada, and will be a suffragan see in the Province of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Cuttack-Bhubaneswar.
